## Partner v0.3.2

This release makes startup and quitting feel more responsive: the API becomes reachable before local voice models load, and quitting from the tray clears the icon immediately.

- **Startup:** The API starts listening first, then warms enabled local TTS and KWS/ASR engines in parallel in the background. Settings, history and schedules stay available while models load. `/api/health` only means the API can accept requests; `/api/voice/local` and `/api/voice` report each engine and voice path as starting, ready, or failed. A live process whose health check times out is no longer reported as ready.
- **Settings and voice:** Saving settings cancels a superseded warmup and applies the latest configuration. The input and output halves now have separate lifetimes, so changing or restarting one no longer tears down the other. Keyword pushes and health polling are cancellable, and the configured "startup wait" is enforced as a real readiness deadline. A failed playback device can still be retried by saving voice settings again.
- **Quit:** Tray → Quit hides the main window and removes the tray icon before backend cleanup, without changing the saved tray preference. The API, MCP servers and engine child processes are still stopped as before.
- **Desktop pet:** The same immediate tray-icon cleanup applies while the pet is running.

## Notes

- These changes are covered by automated API, host and smoke tests; a real Windows cold-start timing comparison and hands-on verification of tray exit and installer handoff are still outstanding.
- Live2D Core and models remain user-supplied. See the [voice](https://github.com/Jaspersol/partner/blob/v0.3.2/doc/voice.en.md), [pet](https://github.com/Jaspersol/partner/blob/v0.3.2/doc/pet.en.md) and [release](https://github.com/Jaspersol/partner/blob/v0.3.2/doc/release.en.md) documentation.
